          How World Rank Works

          FIFA-Style Rating System

          Every club carries one running rating that reflects its true strength, built match by match across every season. There's no reset button. It's earned on the pitch.

          🏆

          Win, and you take points

          The winning club takes rating points from the loser. A draw simply splits the points between both sides.

          ⚖️

          Upsets are worth more

          Beating a higher-rated club earns more points than beating a weaker one. Losing to a weaker club costs more than losing to a favorite.

          🔥

          Bigger stages, bigger swings

          Domestic league matches move the rating a little. The Zenith Group Stage, Quarter-Finals, Semi-Finals and the Final move it much more.

          🏠

          Home advantage counts

          Home clubs get a small boost when the expected result is calculated, just like in real football.

          ♾️

          Nothing ever resets

          Unlike domestic points, World Rank carries over forever. Every match your club has ever played still counts.

          Updated automatically after every single match. No manual adjustments, ever.

          Backup & Transfer Save

          Move your progress to another phone

          Save your entire league as a backup: every club, player, transfer, rookie, stat, ranking, award and record. Download it as a file, or copy it as a code to paste on your other phone.

          Tap the box to select all, then copy. Paste this into the Import tab on your other phone.

          ⚠️

          Importing replaces all current progress on this device. Export a backup first if you want to keep it.
